description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the SortedSet<T> collection in Orleans.Serialization, including classes for serialization, surrogate conversion, and deep copying.

classes.name: SortedSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer class for SortedSet<T> that converts to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: SortedSetSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate data structure for serializing SortedSet<T>, containing list of values and a comparer.

classes.name: SortedSetCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier class for SortedSet<T> that handles copying elements and the set itself.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedSetSurrogate<T> into a SortedSet<T>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedSet<T> into its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SortedSet<T>.
